content.text:
admin_group_claim = instance_admin
   admin_group_claim_path = groups
   bootstrap_completed = true
   instance_name = localhost
   oidc_audience = nebu-gateway
   oidc_client_id = nebu-gateway
   oidc_issuer = http://dex:5556/dex

observation.command: cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U nebu -d nebu -t -c "SELECT '  '||key||' = '||value FROM server_config WHERE key IN ('bootstrap_completed','instance_name','admin_group_claim','admin_group_claim_path','oidc_issuer','oidc_client_id','oidc_audience') ORDER BY key;"
